description:
Free. Check how much USDC is left in your own wallet on Base, so you can tell your human before you run out. Returns the balance and whether it's below your threshold. Read-only: it moves nothing. Tollkit never holds anyone's funds or keys.

When to use: You pay for tools from a wallet and want to know if it's running low.
Use instead: wallet_balance for any wallet, chain or token.
Parameters: address: the wallet you pay from. network: base (default) or sepolia. low_below: your low-balance threshold in USDC, default 1.
Returns: the USDC balance and whether it's below low_below. Free.

address.description: Your wallet address (0x...). The address you pay from.

low_below.description: USDC amount you consider low. Default 1.

network.description: Default base. Use sepolia for test money.

name: check_my_balance
title: Check my wallet balance
